Name: Simple Cellar for PIF
Author: exactlyonewerewolf
Description:
This was made by me in about a half hour to solve an issue I had with making my own version of the farmhouse. I couldn't get the cellar warps to work so I made a little cellar with PIF. It will work with any of the doors enabled by PIF but the decorative hatch item is what I made the cellar in mind for. You can change the walls and floors, put casks down there, and decorate.

Most of the credit goes to DeLiXx, who made their Cozy Sunroom mod available for other people to use to make their own PIF rooms.

Highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28057]Kisaa's More Hatches and Ladders[/url] for more color options for the hatch.
